analogs.covers: Almost everything: a raft of ducks that skims the water, raises young together and flees danger
Personality: curious collector of shiny things that decorates its nest

headline: A raft of mallards that mobs anything near the nest, with a magpie's eye for shiny things.

setting.label: Ponds, lakes, rivers and coasts
setting.note: Sedentary semi-aquatic. Skims the water for lakeweed, small fish and roots, and seeks protection from larger herbivores such as Deinocheirus and Lurdusaurus when separated from the raft.

playsLike: You are a Tiny, quick semi-aquatic herbivore (water sprint 1,350) living in an unlimited 'raft' that raises all the ducklings together. You flee almost every predator from Small tier upward. When a Small-tier carnivore threatens the nests, though, the whole raft mobs it, and you always stand your ground against Compsognathus and Rhamphorhynchus. Newcomers must bathe in mud before they are accepted.

why.text: A group of ducks on water is literally a 'raft', the profile's name for its groups (official inspiration: mallards).
Promiscuous courtship and every adult shows love to every offspring. The whole raft raises the young.
Feeds by skimming through water for lakeweed, small fish and roots, with a soft spot for fruit.
Unlimited numbers team up to mob Small-tier carnivores that threaten the nests, as aggressive as coots at a nest (official inspiration: coots).
Fascinated by shiny objects and decorates its nest with them. Curious, dancing, singing (official inspiration: magpies).

notLike: Mallards escape by flying; Halszkaraptor can't fly and relies on its swimming speed and bigger herbivore friends.
